constants.name: Speed of light in vacuum
constants.description: Speed of all electromagnetic waves in vacuum.

constants.name: Vacuum permittivity
constants.description: Electric constant: how easily electric field lines pass through vacuum.

constants.name: Vacuum permeability
constants.description: Magnetic constant (about 4π×10⁻⁷). Related to c by c² = 1/(ε₀μ₀).

constants.name: Planck constant
constants.description: Relates photon energy and frequency: E = hf.

constants.name: Elementary charge
constants.description: Magnitude of the charge of a proton or electron.

constants.name: Pi
constants.description: Ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter.
